purpose: GENERATION-3 DIFFICULTY FIXTURE. Both prior families saturated: a frontier model one-shots a well-specified single-file ticket. Difficulty hypothesis from our own data: one-shot breaks on a LARGE, UNDER-specified behavioural surface. This fixture replays a real FOUR-COMMIT era on VextrumFrontend's edition renderer (3c8af98 'fixes to reports' -> 778c755 'vector chart and others' -> 707587c 'better report formatting' -> 225e1ef 'citation fixes'; ~470 churn on one module): the before-state renders trend/multi-line charts as text dumps, the after-state draws real vector charts, plus block-citation, formatting, ordering and citation-hygiene changes. The grader is MECHANICAL and GEN-4 (build_era_oracle_gen4.py derives RELATIONAL predicates — kinds-superset and per-kind count-direction — from the era diff over a rich corpus, altformat-filtered), replacing v2's exact projections after the measured validity failure: exact projections from a single reference pinned the reference's rendering choices and graded real agent work zero (evidence/era-instrument-analysis-*.json). Relational predicates reward partial real work while keeping structural red-on-before separation (all 5 pre-registered instrument predictions confirmed, evidence/gen4-era-validation-*.json). Same task workspace and public surface as vextrum-era-v2; ONLY the hidden instrument changed. enum-normalization is now UNGRADED AND NAMED (wording-only change, no countable observable — the gen-4 boundary); sources-section is gen-4-gradable but stays ungraded because no discoverable convention anchors it (fairness rule); bars/ratio/fallback/gaps layouts remain ungraded-named as in v2.

local_source.normalization_note: None needed (verified in v1 and by the era derivation probe): zero top-level imports; jspdf resolves to the fixture stub, editionPdfAssets is optional behind try/catch. The driver uses the era's STABLE public surface (buildEditionDoc || downloadEditionPdf): buildEditionDoc was born DURING the era.
local_source.altformat_note: The middot separator variant (valid-but-different): kills separator-identity pinning at derivation time and proves grader format-agnosticism at admission time.

grading_surface.api: downloadEditionPdf(edition, meta) — the entry point present at every era ref (buildEditionDoc, when present, is preferred by the driver)
grading_surface.recording_stub: public/node_modules/jspdf/index.mjs v2: one `events` stream, text AND drawing in emission order; coordinates rounded to integers by the stub itself so no predicate can pin float layout
grading_surface.mechanical_grader: hidden/grade.py (GEN-4) executes hidden/derived-predicates.json: RELATIONAL discriminating predicates (kinds-superset + count-direction, built by build_era_oracle_gen4.py) + exact textseq preservation guards; 6 graded families. Hand-made parts: the corpus, the family grouping and the family policy (set from the measured instrument validation); every expectation VALUE and every relation baseline is mechanical.

convention_anchors.quote: Trend and multi-line visuals are drawn as real vector charts
A table visual renders its column headers and every row's cells
A citation must not be rendered twice in the same run.
At most three citations are rendered in a run.
Citations in a run are visually separated

A block's own `citations` list renders beneath that block as its numbered
  source references.
Blocks and visuals interleave strictly by their declared `order` key.
Cleaning up how content is presented must never delete what it says.

expected_controls.note: The REAL pre-era module: passes only preserved-behaviour (its own pinned text on the unchanged surface), fails all five change families. Expected deterministic score 17 (1 of 6 families) under the gen-4 grader.

campaign_loop_overrides.reason: Same rationale as vextrum-v1/hermes-etl (measured binding at 30 on v1); the era task is 4x wider, so the raised budget keeps the measured axis the work, not the clock.

interpretation: Underspecified-by-design at scale: a symptom-level task plus discoverable conventions covering a ~470-churn four-commit rework. Every graded family is anchored to a CONVENTIONS.md sentence; five layout-level era changes are ungraded AND NAMED (ungraded_named_dimensions in the grader output) so green never quietly claims them. Score moves in steps of ~17 (6 families). HONEST CAVEATS to publish with any result: same module and repo as vextrum-v1 (this measures the DIFFICULTY axis, not family independence); citation-hygiene rides on a piece-count projection, which assumes the agent extends the module's existing emission granularity rather than rewriting it — a rewrite that changes granularity would fail that family for a debatable reason (flagged, not hidden).
